ui.d4506701199c3433: What if I do not have a school-issued ID?
ui.29ced487e51667b4: After taking your selfie, choose the alternative-ID option. Passport, driver’s license, national ID, and other government identification submissions require manual review.
ui.c93a7eac05fe78eb: Can I change my language later?
ui.bbb4d402eb9fc2cf: Yes. Use the language selector or your account settings. Non-English translations are drafts pending language review, and unavailable translations appear in English.
ui.c4cd8222937c7475: No. Verification evidence is encrypted and available only through protected administrator review routes after a clean security scan.
ui.bad132a35c7ec024: Can I manage or cancel Premium?
ui.97d082b138041bdd: Use Billing to manage your membership. Cancellation is scheduled for the end of the paid period. Checkout and billing actions require the payment service to be available.
